create_random_video_frame_sampler: create a RandomSampling instance to randomly sample N video frames from a clip with configurable interval and speed
run_random_sampling_on_clip: run the RandomSampling sampling method on a video clip with a given range_max to get sampled frame indices
create_evenly_spaced_video_frame_sampler: create an EvenlySampling instance to evenly sample N frames across multiple clips with a fixed interval
run_evenly_sampling_on_clip: run the EvenlySampling sampling method on a video clip with range_max, v_id, and copy_id to get evenly spaced frame indices
review_video_sampler_classes: review the RandomSampling and EvenlySampling classes to understand their frame sampling strategies and parameters
